quote: Martin virtually conducted an Online Presentation Skills Training Workshop for our team at Trycon Technologies (Scanova). The content of the workshop as well as Martin was very engaging, interactive, and insightful. It was an amazing experience to have had Martin with us for the session. Even before scheduling the session, we had a 30-minute discussion session wherein Martin wanted to know what our team really wanted. And he focused exactly on that. Martin truly is a people person. Thank you, Martin and ITD! Wishing you all the very best!
author: Mahima Singh
subject: Presentation Skills
